name: readout
title: Readout
summary: One setting read at a distance: a mono label over a large value with its unit.
use: For the settings that define a state: lens 24 mm, mode AUTO, ISO 250, tempo 128.0.
Group them in a grid of hairline cells; tap one to change it.

options.name: value
options.description: The value as people read it.

options.name: dim
options.description: In faint, for a value that is off or not in use.

options.name: live
options.description: An accent dot after the label, for the value being set now.

rules: The value is at title size, never larger.
At most one live readout at a time.
accessibility: The label and value are read together, as “Lens, 24 mm”.
